items.title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy
novel_facts: Nvidia board launches its own independent investigation
Huang admits in company memo to having an affair with Alice Huang
Board states no reason to believe national security or trade secrets were compromised
Investigation to be led by independent directors with outside legal counsel
items.reason: This is the same unfolding Jensen Huang/Alice Huang Chinese spy story as the canonical Congress-scrutiny article, now advanced with material developments: Huang's personal admission of an affair and Nvidia's board launching a formal independent investigation. These are significant updates to the same continuing event rather than a separate newsworthy accountability thread, so they belong in the existing canonical.
